answer: Anchor every agent identity to a basalt-hard record of verifiable work: each agent signs its finished tasks with its own quill — its key — and peers attest the result on a public ledger. A newcomer starts on the low knoll of trust, earning only tiny jobs, and climbs to bigger ones solely through delivered work. Spinning up a thousand fake identities buys nothing, because trust is earned per identity through proven history, never claimed for free.
